summary: First-finish smoke test of AIoT Belt-Sentinel dashboard. All 5 scenario endpoints, timeseries, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 SSE streaming verified end-to-end. Frontend loads, scenario switching updates health gauge, CNN bbox, joint status, and AI recommendation stream renders live tokens.
passed: GET /api/scenarios returns all 5 scenarios (normal, loose_joint, damaged_joint, misalignment, overload)
snapshot damaged_joint: health=34.2, iso_zone=D, 1 critical alert, cnn_detection bbox 0.92 conf, J2 status=critical
snapshot loose_joint: 1 warning alert (alrt-loose-j2), J2 status=warning, others healthy
snapshot misalignment: 1 warning alert, all 4 joints in warning state
snapshot overload: 1 critical alert, motor_current=32.24A (>25A), belt_speed=1.402 (reduced)
timeseries damaged_joint points=60: vibration/thermal/motor_current/belt_speed/anomaly_score/t all length 60, health_30d length 30
SSE /api/ai/recommendation damaged_joint: streams multi-token engineering maintenance text (ROOT CAUSE, IMMEDIATE ACTION, FOLLOW-UP, RISK IF IGNORED), ends with [DONE]
SSE /api/ai/recommendation normal: streams 'All splice joints operating within nominal thresholds. No maintenance action required.' + [DONE]
Frontend dashboard-root, sidebar, executive-banner load within 15s
Scenario switch to damaged_joint: vision-bbox rendered, joint-card-J2 shows critical
Scenario switch to normal: vision-bbox removed
ai-recommend-alrt-damaged-j2 button triggers stream and populates output within a few seconds (115+ chars observed)
All 4 telemetry tabs (vibration, thermal, motor, anomaly) switch without JS errors
minor_notes: joint-card-J2 has no data-status attribute (test relied on inner text instead); recharts logs benign 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings during initial container mount
